title: Establishment of the early prediction models of low-birth-weight reveals influential genetic and environmental factors: a prospective cohort study.
summary: BirThree cohort datasets include maternal assessments, SNPs, and fetal ultrasound; term/preterm models and validation are reported. The reviewed source supports this bounded result; external generalization, causal effects, and sustained operational impact remain unestablished where the source reports retrospective or internal evaluation.
